summary: A necessary lower endpoint is omitted while the displayed system is called complete.
The retained exact-minor checker establishes a rank condition, while the non-extension conclusion additionally requires an external theorem that the export does not prove or bind.
The verified combinatorial census does not by itself certify the vector or classical Bell value.
No positive error is established at the supplied locator. The source never asserts the stronger individual bound attributed to it in the historical ledger.
The imported result and its displayed bound do not by themselves license the retained-radius, tensor-Haar estimate in the local lemma.
The headline quantifier exceeds the pure alternating direction treated in the derivation, but explicit adjacent exclusions may already delimit the intended statement.
The headline and retained certification status disagree; without isolating an unproved mathematical dependency this may be a status-language issue rather than a mathematical error.

A zero criterion must specify the choice of a circuit representative and the round assignment. The archived critique identifies a type/definition ambiguity, not an actual source equation asserting that a voltage set literally equals the scalar zero.
At k=0 the set over which a logical-distance minimum is taken is empty. A finite logical witness is unavailable, so the theorem needs an explicit k≥1 restriction or an extended-real convention.
The collision-merging proof needs the allowed alphabet to be closed under local multiplication and uses a compatible uniform cost. Unit weights alone do not provide group closure.

Constant-diagonal feasibility is preserved by permutations, not by arbitrary orthogonal conjugation. Whether this is an actual scope error depends on which inherited assumptions governed the shorthand node.

The historical objection would apply to a direct conversion that ignored the factor of two between sign-approximation error and quantum failure probability. The original review request explicitly flags that factor, so the objection does not establish an error in the quoted request or in the correct LP table.
